THSL.description: Time Varying Static Load (THSL). Links a time history load case (THIS_LCNAME) to a static load case (SLOAD) and a normal-type time history function (THIS_FUNCNAME), scaled by SCALE and offset by ATIME; the key is the time varying static load id.

THIS_LCNAME.description: Name of the time history load case (must reference an existing time history load case).

SLOAD.description: Name of the static load case whose pattern is applied over time (must reference an existing static load case).

THIS_FUNCNAME.description: Name of the (normal type) time history function that governs the time variation (must reference an existing time history function).

ATIME.description: Arrival time (time offset before the load begins to act).

SCALE.description: Scale factor applied to the static load pattern.
